nodes.label: src/sites/sites.test.ts content validation
nodes.community_name: Tema, tipos y validación de contenido
nodes.rationale: Safety net when editing a client's config/content: unique slugs, ISO dates, ratings 1-5, review-project links, alt text, hex colors, WCAG AA contrast.

nodes.label: Rule 5: colors via theme tokens
nodes.community_name: Tema, tipos y validación de contenido
nodes.rationale: No hex or fixed Tailwind palettes so dark (barbershop) and light (construction) themes both work with one component.

nodes.label: Rule 6: types first (src/types)
nodes.community_name: Tema, tipos y validación de contenido

nodes.label: graphify usage rules (query before grep, update after edits)
nodes.norm_label: graphify usage rules (query before grep, update after edits)
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph queries are smaller than raw grep or GRAPH_REPORT.md; graph.json diffs are expected to be large.

nodes.label: ESLint 10 ERESOLVE peer warnings
nodes.rationale: eslint-plugin-react/jsx-a11y/import don't declare ESLint 10 yet; warnings expected and rules verified.

nodes.label: TypeScript pinned ~6.0
nodes.rationale: typescript-eslint only supports <6.1; TS 7 (Go native) exposes no JS API and breaks lint.

nodes.label: Customizing a business (config.ts, content.ts, images, single site)
nodes.norm_label: customizing a business (config.ts, content.ts, images, single site)

nodes.label: Rule 3: single source per datum (config.ts vs content.ts)
nodes.norm_label: rule 3: single source per datum (config.ts vs content.ts)

nodes.label: Code conventions (strict TS, named exports, @/ alias, English code / Spanish UI and docs)
nodes.norm_label: code conventions (strict ts, named exports, @/ alias, english code / spanish ui and docs)

nodes.label: Global route types (PageProps, LayoutProps via next typegen)
nodes.norm_label: global route types (pageprops, layoutprops via next typegen)

nodes.label: business-web-starter (template base)
nodes.rationale: Initial version for business sites; each client is created via Use this template and evolves separately with no automatic sync.

nodes.label: Cache Components (use cache, cacheLife, connection)
nodes.rationale: Unstable values in render need use cache + cacheLife, await connection() or a client component; legacy segment config exports (dynamic, revalidate, etc.) don't exist.

nodes.label: CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Lint+unit once, build+E2E per site matrix, final 'CI completo' job; Vercel doesn't run tests.

nodes.label: E2E tests (Playwright, e2e/, Pixel 7 + desktop)
nodes.rationale: Async Server Components can only be tested here because Vitest doesn't support them.

nodes.label: generateStaticParams placeholder + async params
nodes.rationale: Must return at least one param under Cache Components.

nodes.label: Minimum quality (a11y, mobile-first, next/image Media, SEO, real content)
nodes.norm_label: minimum quality (a11y, mobile-first, next/image media, seo, real content)

nodes.label: Node 24 LTS requirement (engines.node, .nvmrc, .npmrc engine-strict)
nodes.rationale: engines.node is the source read by Vercel and next.config.ts; Vercel only offers 22.x and 24.x.

nodes.label: Per-user data with Cache Components (cookies/headers outside use cache, Suspense)
nodes.norm_label: per-user data with cache components (cookies/headers outside use cache, suspense)

nodes.label: Scaling a clone (demos removal, sections, pages, login, DB/CMS, forms, e-commerce, remote images)
nodes.norm_label: scaling a clone (demos removal, sections, pages, login, db/cms, forms, e-commerce, remote images)

nodes.label: Mandatory verification: lint + test + build (+ e2e)
nodes.norm_label: mandatory verification: lint + test + build (+ e2e)
nodes.rationale: In base, also build and e2e with SITE_ID=barbershop to confirm change doesn't depend on one business.

nodes.label: Continuous integration and ruleset setup
nodes.rationale: Vercel only builds and publishes, so branch protection with required checks prevents broken code reaching production.

nodes.label: How to grow a project (outside base)
nodes.norm_label: how to grow a project (outside base)

nodes.label: Use this template workflow (clones don't sync)
nodes.norm_label: use this template workflow (clones don't sync)

nodes.label: This is NOT the Next.js you know
nodes.norm_label: this is not the next.js you know
nodes.rationale: Next.js 16 has breaking API/convention changes vs training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code.

nodes.label: Base vs client clone contexts
nodes.rationale: Base accepts only generic changes; clones may extend freely (login, DB, routes) while respecting architecture; generic clone improvements are ported manually.

nodes.label: Business-agnostic tests (e2e/site.ts, activeSite.content)
nodes.rationale: Never hardcode business text in tests so they pass with any SITE_ID and any clone.

nodes.label: main branch protection (required checks: Lint y tests unitarios, CI completo)
nodes.norm_label: main branch protection (required checks: lint y tests unitarios, ci completo)
nodes.rationale: Only matrix-independent job names are required so matrix changes don't break protection; template doesn't copy GitHub settings.

nodes.label: Nonexistent /trabajos/<slug> returns 200 with noindex
nodes.rationale: Cache Components streaming means not-found renders after headers are sent; E2E checks noindex, not HTTP code.

nodes.label: Rule 1: business-agnostic components
nodes.rationale: Components receive everything via props and never import @/lib/site, @/lib/data or @/sites; wiring happens in src/app.

nodes.label: Rule 2: content only via src/lib/data.ts
nodes.rationale: Switching to DB/CMS rewrites getter bodies keeping signatures; components never read DB.

nodes.label: Rule 4: generic vocabulary in code, labels in config
nodes.norm_label: rule 4: generic vocabulary in code, labels in config

nodes.label: Server Components by default; use client minimal
nodes.norm_label: server components by default; use client minimal
